notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Notes
notes.notes:
Howdy, friends.

This patch fixes some bugs that we didn't notice before release — whoops! 

 Changes  

     The player can no longer move while a level loads
     The reset mechanic is now disabled on the first and last levels

 Fixes 

     Fixed a bug that prevented players from moving on the third ice stage
